# Maxinor

> India's first operator-led venture studio. We build, scale, and back startups, SMEs, and corporates through hands-on execution — not just capital.

Maxinor (mlabs.co.in) is an operator-led venture studio based in India. Unlike traditional VCs or accelerators, Maxinor embeds experienced operators directly into portfolio companies to drive measurable outcomes. The model combines capital with execution expertise across four pillars: Venture Build, Venture Scale, Venture Investment, and Shared AI Capability.

## What Maxinor Does

### Four Core Pillars

**Venture Build** — Startup Creation Engine
Maxinor identifies validated white spaces and co-creates AI-native companies from scratch, covering idea validation, product engineering, go-to-market, and founding team assembly.

**Venture Scale** — Execution Led Engine
For existing founder-led ventures, Maxinor embeds operators across four engines: Revenue (GTM, marketing, business development, pricing), Operations (supply chain, finance, marketing ops), Product & Design (strategy, UX, growth, product ops), and AI & Data (agentic AI, data architecture, automation, platform builds).

**Venture Investment** — Milestone-Linked Capital
Maxinor deploys capital linked to execution milestones rather than time-based tranches, aligning incentives with actual business progress.

**Shared AI Capability** — Operator Infrastructure
Portfolio companies access shared capabilities across Tech, Product, HR, Supply Chain, Marketing, and Operations — reducing the cost and time to build foundational functions.

### Engagement Models

- **Venture Sprint**: 30-day diagnostic and roadmap
- **Venture Partner**: 6-month embedded execution with equity + Series A preparation
- **Venture CXO**: 6–12 month fractional C-level leadership

## Who We Work With

- **Founders** at pre-seed to Series A stage looking for execution partners, not just advisors
- **SMEs** with ₹0–100 Cr+ revenue seeking digital transformation, operational efficiency, talent-as-a-service, and risk management
- **Corporates** building internal accelerators, venture spin-offs, or pursuing strategic startup partnerships
- **Investors** (angels, family offices, institutions) wanting access to operator-vetted deal flow and co-investment opportunities
- **Operators & CXOs** interested in fractional and embedded leadership roles with equity upside

## Domains We Work In

- **Consumer & Retail**: Media, D2C & B2C
- **Tech & Infrastructure**: AI & Data, FinTech
- **Specialised Sectors**: Healthcare, Defence

## Portfolio Companies

Maxinor backs and builds ventures including IZF (izfworld.com), Nattier (nattier.co.in), Kachs (responcibleai.com), Adaapt (adaapt.ai), and Aseed International (aseedinternational.org).
